name: Message of the Day
description: The line every player is greeted with at login.

keys.note: mangosd reads this once, at startup, and sends it to each character as it enters the world

patches.replace: Motd = "Welcome to Turtle WoW! @/join world to connect with the community around you!"
patches.note: the line this fork ships at /opt/tortoise/etc/mangosd.conf:901

notes: The TBC sibling of this manifest is proved on the console with `.server motd`. THAT
COMMAND DOES NOT EXIST ON THIS FORK: its serverCommandTable is corpses/exit/
700-711), and `motd` appears nowhere in its command tables (grepped, m910q 2026-09-08).
The only thing that reports this value here is a logging-in CLIENT:
each piece as a system message. So this item's proof needs the 1.18.1 Turtle client; the
`perf-report` item is the one 8.7d gated on the console instead.
Do not put a double quote in the text: the value is written into a quoted conf field.
